about: v684 reference fixtures — 5 target words x 3 planned recalls per language. DESIGNED BY CLAUDE (the coding assistant) as reference material for the teaching-plan and final-gate contracts. NOT Gemini output, NOT reviewed by a native speaker. Each recall states its sense, its communicative function and intent (who says what to whom and why), the exchange it lives in, the cue, the sentence, its meaning and pronunciation. Thai phonetics use the app's display convention (aa/ii/uu doubled for long vowels, aw/aaw = short/long ɔ, ae/aae = short/long ɛ, oe/ooe = short/long ə, ue/uue = short/long ɯ; tone marks: grave low, acute high, circumflex falling, caron rising). Mandarin: 'pinyin' = dictionary (citation) tones, 'spoken' = tones as pronounced (sandhi), present only where they differ.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: a traveller tells the station attendant who has just explained the way that he understands

exchange.cue: The station attendant has just shown you where the bus is. Tell them politely that you understand.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Yumi asks her friend whether he understands Japanese before she switches language

exchange.cue: Ask your friend whether they understand Japanese.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Yumi admits she does not know the answer to her friend's question

exchange.cue: Your friend asks what time the bus is. Say sorry, you don't know.

recalls.sense: no — polite answer to a yes/no question

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: a traveller tells the attendant he is not getting on this train

exchange.text: この電車に乗りますか？
exchange.reading: このでんしゃにのりますか？
exchange.en: Are you getting on this train?

exchange.cue: A station attendant asks if you are getting on this train. Say politely that you are not.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: a customer corrects the assistant who picked up the wrong item

exchange.en: No, it's that one over there.
exchange.cue: The shop assistant picks up a book and asks if it is the one you want. Say politely no, it's that one over there.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: a customer politely declines the water that the waiter offers him

exchange.reading: いいえ、だいじょうぶです。
exchange.cue: At a restaurant the waiter offers you water. Politely say no, you're fine.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Kenji asks Yumi whether she is going anywhere tomorrow

exchange.cue: Ask your friend if they are going anywhere tomorrow.

exchange.text: うん、友達と映画を見るよ。
exchange.reading: うん、ともだちとえいがをみるよ。
exchange.romaji: un, tomodachi to eiga o miru yo.
exchange.en: Yeah, I'm seeing a film with a friend.

intent.speaker: B
intent.situation: after a friend says he wants to see a film
intent.purpose: Yumi suggests they go together

exchange.en: I'd like to see that film.

exchange.text: じゃあ、一緒に行こうよ。
exchange.reading: じゃあ、いっしょにいこうよ。
exchange.cue: Your friend says they want to see a film. Suggest going together.

intent.speaker: B
intent.situation: a friend asks about the shop
intent.purpose: Yumi explains she is not going today because she is busy

exchange.en: Are you going to the shop today?

exchange.text: 忙しいから、今日は行かない。
exchange.reading: いそがしいから、きょうはいかない。
exchange.en: I'm busy, so I'm not going today.
exchange.cue: Your friend asks if you're going to the shop today. Say you're busy, so you're not going today.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: a traveller politely asks staff where the toilet is

exchange.text: すみません、トイレはどこですか？
exchange.reading: すみません、といれはどこですか？
exchange.romaji: sumimasen, toire wa doko desu ka?
exchange.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
exchange.cue: At the station, politely ask a staff member where the toilet is.

intent.speaker: B
intent.situation: on the phone, friend is late
intent.purpose: Yumi phones her late friend to find out where he is

exchange.cue: Your friend is late. Phone them and ask where they are now.

exchange.en: Sorry, I'm still at the station.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Kenji asks where his friend bought it so he can get one too

exchange.cue: Your friend shows you something new. Ask where they bought it.

exchange.en: At the shop in the station.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Yumi asks whether her friend likes films before suggesting the cinema

exchange.cue: Before suggesting the cinema, ask your friend if they like films.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Yumi tells her friend which one she prefers

exchange.cue: Your friend asks which of the two you want. Say you like this one.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Kenji turns down a film because he does not like it

exchange.text: うーん、それは好きじゃない。
exchange.reading: うーん、それはすきじゃない。
exchange.romaji: uun, sore wa suki ja nai.
exchange.en: Hmm, I don't like that one.
exchange.cue: Your friend suggests watching a film you don't like. Say, hesitantly, that you don't like that one.

recalls.sense: a little (more) — softening a request for change

intent.speaker: B
intent.situation: a friend is speaking too fast
intent.purpose: she asks her friend to speak a bit more slowly so she can follow

exchange.en: Could you speak a bit more slowly?
exchange.cue: Your friend is speaking too fast for you. Ask them to speak a bit more slowly.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: she accepts, but only a small amount

exchange.cue: Your friend offers you a drink. Say OK, you'll have a little.

intent.speaker: A
intent.situation: in a shop, the item is too small
intent.purpose: a customer asks whether there is a slightly bigger one

exchange.en: Do you have a slightly bigger one?
exchange.cue: In a shop, this one is too small. Ask if they have one a bit bigger.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: he asks his friend to wait a moment while he gets ready

exchange.cue: Your friend wants to leave but you're not ready. Ask them to wait for you a moment.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: she tells her friend where she is waiting for him

exchange.en: I'm waiting for you at home.
exchange.cue: Your friend phones to ask where you are. Say you're waiting for them at home.

intent.speaker: A
intent.situation: seeing a friend standing outside a shop
intent.purpose: he asks who she is waiting for

exchange.cue: Your friend is standing outside a shop looking around. Ask who they are waiting for.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: a customer asks whether he may take a look at an item

exchange.cue: In a shop, ask the assistant if you may have a look at it.

intent.speaker: B
intent.situation: a friend wants to borrow something
intent.purpose: she lets her friend use it

exchange.en: Sure, go ahead and use it.
exchange.cue: Your friend asks if they can use this. Say sure, go ahead and use it.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: he asks whether his friend can come tomorrow

exchange.cue: You're planning to meet. Ask your friend if they can come tomorrow.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: he asks what his friend would like to drink so he can order

exchange.en: What would you like to drink?
exchange.cue: You're about to order. Ask your friend what they'd like to drink.

intent.speaker: B
intent.situation: a friend is searching for something
intent.purpose: she asks what he is looking for, to help

exchange.cue: Your friend is searching for something. Ask what they're looking for.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: he did not hear and asks his friend to repeat

exchange.cue: You didn't catch what your friend just said. Ask what they said.

exchange.pinyin: wǒ shuō, wǒmen míngtiān qù ba.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: she asks whether her friend is going home now

exchange.cue: It's getting late. Ask your friend if they're going home now.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: he tells his friend that he will come back tomorrow, not today

exchange.cue: Your friend asks if you're coming back today. Say you'll be back tomorrow instead.

intent.speaker: B
intent.situation: on the way out, something forgotten
intent.purpose: she explains she has to go back to get something

exchange.en: I need to go back and get something.
exchange.cue: You've left something at home. Tell your friend you need to go back and get it.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Somchai suggests to his friend that they go for a walk after eating

exchange.text: หลังกินข้าว เราไปเดินกันไหมครับ
exchange.ph: lǎng gin khâao rao bpai dooen gan mǎi khráp
exchange.en: After we eat, shall we go for a walk?
exchange.cue: You are finishing lunch with a friend. Suggest going for a walk after you eat.

exchange.text: ดีค่ะ ไปไหนดีคะ
exchange.ph: dii khâ bpai nǎi dii khá
exchange.en: Good idea — where shall we go?

exchange.text: ไปร้านกาแฟกันครับ
exchange.en: Let's go to the coffee shop.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: the waitress tells a customer that the toilet is at the back of the shop

exchange.text: ห้องน้ำอยู่ที่ไหนครับ
อยู่หลังร้านค่ะ
exchange.en: It's at the back of the shop.
exchange.cue: You work in a café. A customer asks where the toilet is: tell him it is at the back of the shop.

exchange.text: ขอบคุณครับ

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Nida agrees to meet her friend tomorrow and says it should be after five o'clock

exchange.text: พรุ่งนี้เจอกันไหมครับ
ได้ค่ะ เจอกันหลังห้าโมงเย็นนะคะ
exchange.ph: dâi khâ jooe gan lǎng hâa-moong-yen ná khá
exchange.cue: Your friend asks to meet tomorrow. Agree, and say to meet after five in the evening.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Somchai tells his host that he has had enough rice and thanks her

exchange.text: เอาข้าวอีกไหมคะ
พอแล้วครับ ขอบคุณครับ
exchange.cue: Your host offers you more rice. Say that is enough, and thank her.

exchange.text: ไม่เป็นไรค่ะ

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Somchai checks whether his friend has enough money before she pays

exchange.text: เงินพอไหมครับ
exchange.cue: Your friend is about to pay. Ask if she has enough money.

exchange.text: งั้นไปกันครับ

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Nida tells her friend that there is not enough food for everyone yet

exchange.text: ทุกคนได้กินหรือยังครับ
exchange.ph: thúk khon dâi gin rǔue yang khráp

exchange.text: ยังค่ะ ข้าวไม่พอค่ะ
exchange.ph: yang khâ khâao mâi phaaw khâ
exchange.en: Not yet — there isn't enough food.
exchange.cue: Your friend asks if everyone has eaten. Say not yet, there is not enough food.

exchange.text: งั้นผมไปซื้ออีกครับ
exchange.ph: ngán phǒm bpai súue ìik khráp
exchange.en: Then I'll go and buy more.

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Somchai says what he likes to drink and asks his friend the same question

exchange.text: ผมชอบกาแฟครับ คุณล่ะครับ
exchange.ph: phǒm châawp gaa-fae khráp khun lâ khráp
exchange.en: I like coffee. What about you?
exchange.cue: You are choosing drinks. Say you like coffee, then ask your friend what about her.

exchange.text: ฉันชอบชาค่ะ
ร้านนี้มีชาครับ

recalls.sense: what about that one? (offer an alternative)

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Somchai points to another item after his friend rejects the first one

exchange.text: อันนี้ไม่ชอบค่ะ
อันนั้นล่ะครับ
exchange.cue: Your friend doesn't like this one. Point to another one and ask what about that one.

exchange.text: อันนั้นดีค่ะ

intent.speaker: A
intent.purpose: Somchai asks his friend where they should go now that the shop is closed

exchange.text: ร้านปิดแล้วค่ะ
แล้วเราจะไปไหนล่ะครับ
exchange.ph: láaeo rao jà bpai nǎi lâ khráp
exchange.en: So where shall we go then?
exchange.cue: Your friend says the shop is closed. Ask where you should go then.

exchange.text: ไปร้านกาแฟกันค่ะ
exchange.en: Let's go to the coffee shop.

intent.speaker: A
intent.situation: a tourist asks the way to the station
intent.purpose: Somchai tells a lost tourist to go straight on and that she will see the station

exchange.text: สถานีไปทางไหนคะ
ตรงไปครับ แล้วจะเจอสถานีครับ
exchange.ph: dtrong-bpai khráp láaeo jà jooe sà-thǎa-nii khráp
exchange.en: Go straight on and you'll see the station.
exchange.cue: A tourist asks you the way to the station. Tell her to go straight on and she will see it.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Nida checks with the passer-by that she has understood his directions correctly

exchange.text: สถานีอยู่ทางนั้นครับ
ตรงไปใช่ไหมคะ
exchange.cue: A passer-by points the way to the station. Check with him that you go straight ahead.

intent.speaker: A
intent.situation: in a car near the destination
intent.purpose: Somchai tells the driver that they have not arrived yet and should keep going a little further

exchange.text: ตรงนี้ใช่ไหมคะ
ยังครับ ตรงไปอีกหน่อยครับ
exchange.ph: yang khráp dtrong-bpai ìik nòi khráp
exchange.en: Not yet — a bit further straight on.
exchange.cue: The driver asks if this is the place. Say not yet, go a bit further straight on.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Nida asks her friend whether he is angry with her because he has gone quiet

exchange.text: คุณโกรธฉันเหรอคะ
exchange.cue: Your friend has gone quiet. Ask if he is angry with you.

exchange.text: ไม่ครับ ไม่เป็นไรครับ

intent.speaker: A
intent.situation: his friend apologises for being late
intent.purpose: Somchai reassures his friend that he is not angry about her being late

exchange.text: ขอโทษนะคะ ฉันมาสาย
ไม่เป็นไรครับ ผมไม่โกรธครับ
exchange.ph: mâi-bpen-rai khráp phǒm mâi gròot khráp
exchange.cue: Your friend apologises for being late. Tell her it is OK, you are not angry.

intent.speaker: B
intent.purpose: Nida explains to her friend why their other friend is angry

exchange.text: เพื่อนคุณเป็นอะไรครับ
เขาโกรธเพราะเรามาสายค่ะ
exchange.ph: khǎo gròot phráw rao maa-sǎai khâ
exchange.en: He's angry because we were late.
exchange.cue: Your friend asks what is wrong with your other friend. Say he is angry because you were late.

exchange.text: งั้นไปขอโทษเขากันครับ
exchange.ph: ngán bpai khǎaw-thôot khǎo gan khráp
exchange.en: Then let's go and apologise to him.
